resources.string: Pick open app action with app image

This is a launcher that works on swipes. Tap anywhere on the screen to bring up the menu, then, without releasing your finger, drag it to the item you need. The action specified for this element will be executed.
A menu can have up to 8 items. They are located as shown above. All menus can be changed in settings.

1. Open app
2. Open circle menu (opens a new menu at this location)
3. Open settings (opens launcher settings)
4. Call (makes a call to the specified phone number)
5. Dial(opens the calling application with the entered phone number, all you have to do is press the button to make a call)
6. Turn on the flashlight
7. Turn off the flashlight
8. Change flashlight condition (if it’s on, then turn it off and if it’s off, then turn it on)
9. Open url
1. App image\n2. Default image (select from the list provided)\n3. User image (after selecting the picture is automatically saved in the application, you can delete the original)

To open a list of all applications, double-tap anywhere. Clicking on an application will open it. When you press and hold, an application editing window will appear, in which you can change its name and icon, as well as hide, delete, or view detailed information about it. You can find all hidden applications in settings.

To get to the launcher settings, in the list of all applications, find and open the SwipeLauncher application. Explanation of the meaning of some settings:
1. All circle menus - go to the list of all circle menus
2. Change default launcher - redirects to the settings screen with the choice of default launcher
3. Open last app - when searching in the list of all applications, if only one application satisfies the request, then it automatically opens (no need to click on it)
4. Click on clock - action when clicking on the clock (it is best to set the clock application to open)
5. Black text color on wallpaper - if your wallpaper is very light, then the text color on it can be made black. (does not turn on automatically when installing light wallpaper).
6. Pick open app action with app image - when editing a menu item for it, you need to select an icon and an action, so if you want this element to open an application, then you would have to first select the icon of this application, and then the action to open it , now, when you select an application icon, the action automatically changes to open this application.
In the list of all menus, you can add a new menu, delete an old one (delete works for all but the main one, delete by pressing and holding) or change an existing one.

To open the menu change window, in the list of all menus, click on the desired menu. You can change the name of the menu (works for everyone except the main one), to do this, change the text at the top. You can also add a new item (if there are not already 8 of them), to do this, click on the add icon in the required place on the menu. You can also edit menu items and delete them. When you click on the name of an action type for an element, you open a dialog in which you can select a different type and action. When you click on the action itself, you open a dialog for editing this action. For example, if you have the “Open app” action selected, then when you click on the application icon, you can replace it with another one. The same works for images.
You can set SwipeLauncher as your default launcher in system settings. Your choice can always be changed in the launcher settings and in the system settings.
